mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing output contraction that reduces corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High non-farm payroll employment (above 130,000) indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index above 215 signals elevated inflation that prompts Federal Reserve monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts signals broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening with high inflation (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 215) compresses equity valuations through rising rates and persistent inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 215, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
